feature: Prompt engineering: A+B hybrid investigation method (rubric + staged CoT + router prior)
problem: Post-leak baseline (n=5): D1=0.40, D2=0.08, D3=0.13, D6=0.85. Agent grounds evidence but hedges to MEDIUM on buggy commits and describes structure not failure mechanisms. spike-0 docs and research define the fix; code not yet changed.
proposed_solution: Implement spike §5.2 system prompt (Architecture A+B hybrid: risk rubric with mechanism floor + four-stage reasoning in JSON reasoning field), inject router_probability per §5.3, embed two abstract few-shot examples. Add fix-commit residual-risk rubric guard (verdict consistent with SUPPORTED mechanism — addresses b4c933b7 D3↑ D1↓). Run n=5 smoke then n=20 stratified validation.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: orchestrator.py system prompt replaced with spike §5.2 template (four stages, rubric tiers, hedge-ban rules, two few-shot examples)
AC-2: router_probability injected in context assembly per spike §5.3 format (ML prior disclaimer, route enum)
AC-3: Fix-commit residual-risk rule in prompt: SUPPORTED mechanistic hypothesis → risk_level MUST be ≥ HIGH; verdict must not downgrade due to fix-commit framing
AC-4: n=5 stratified smoke passes with D6≥0.70 (hard revert if below)
AC-5: Individual smoke on f897d46, 90846b5, b4c933b7 — document risk_level and D3-relevant reasoning for each
AC-6: n=20 stratified eval completes; targets D1≥0.50, D3≥0.18 (interim targets — gate is 0.70/0.20 at n=50)
AC-7: 76+ tests pass; oracle isolation tests unchanged
AC-8: No infrastructure changes except prompt and context injection (no multi-turn enable, no bundle expansion in iter-1)
AC-9: 3 random n=20 reports checked for few-shot example parroting (no copied example text)
AC-10: Breadcrumb with before/after scores vs n=5 baseline
edge_cases: EC-1: Router probability may correlate with buggy — agent must treat as prior not label; oracle isolation tests verify no GT leak
EC-2: Few-shot parroting — agent copies 'HYPOTHESIS: If null property...' verbatim instead of reasoning from diff
EC-3: D6 regression from assertive rubric — if n=5 D6<0.70, revert rubric floor before router injection
EC-4: f897d46 may remain MEDIUM if rubric lacks 'large untested surface' criterion — document and propose rubric amendment if smoke fails
verification_method: Builder runs pytest (76+). Smoke n=5 stratified real eval. Validate n=20 stratified. Evaluator checks: prompt matches §5.2 intent, router_probability present in context, per-commit forensics on 3 named commits, D6 guard holds, parroting check on 3 reports.
